claim: agentgateway's initial standalone inference-routing implementation was deliberately fail-closed: if EPP routing fails, the request is rejected rather than falling back to a default endpoint.
stance_target: maintainers weighed fail-open vs fail-closed for standalone EPP routing and started conservative
quoted_support: Keep standalone inference routing fail-closed (for now).

claim: A maintainer explicitly rejected adding a stricter type guard that would prevent inference routing from being configured on non-Service backend types, on the grounds that agentgateway already permits this elsewhere and the guard would add ~190 LOC to protect an edge case.
stance_target: agentgateway should restrict InferenceRouting configuration to Kubernetes Service-backed targets only
scope_conditions: agentgateway local config type system, code review discussion
quoted_support: I don't know this split is worth doing. I assume the goal is to avoid Inference routing on non-Service types, but we already allow that in other places (like LocalRouteBackend) so adding ~190 LOC to avoid it in one place (that is used by 0.01% of people) doesn't seem great.

claim: Even in the standalone/local-config EPP path, the author's stated open work item was to document that model workloads require a Kubernetes Service object, indicating a k8s Service is still assumed as the addressing/discovery anchor even when pods themselves are not required.
stance_target: degree to which standalone EPP routing removes Kubernetes dependencies entirely
quoted_support: Document the required Kubernetes deps, e.g. model workloads require a k8s Service.
